_comment: Wrong-type field values — each is intentionally the wrong JSON type for its key. Expected: every wrong-type field logs a LOG_CORE_ERROR 'must be a <type>' line; ConfigParser continues to the next field; the queue folder + API interfaces survive so the overall parse state stays ConfigOk.
_expected_errors: ConfigParser: 'max threads' must be a number
ConfigParser: 'engine sleep time in run loop in ms' must be a number
ConfigParser: 'max file size in kB' must be a number
ConfigParser: 'API index' must be a number
ConfigParser: 'jcwf batch size' must be a number
ConfigParser: 'jcwf AI interface' must be a number
ConfigParser: 'MaxRequestBodyMB' must be a non-negative number
ConfigParser: 'max inflight ai calls' must be a number
ConfigParser: 'python engines' must be a number
ConfigParser: API interface 'description' must be a string
ConfigParser: API interface 'is_mock' must be a bool
